paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Shelach 162a. He and his son descended into the cave; see there for the whole incident.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Vocalized Zohar, Israel 2013 paragraph of Sh'lach 12:94 explicitly names Rabbi Ilai of Netzivin with his son and their entering the cave’s darkness. This supports the local full title and the father-and-son direction. Hyman’s Shelach 162a locator and “see there” pointer are retained; no additional fate, narrative figures, or supernatural claim is imported.
